description.zh-CN: 精确代码编辑：字符串替换 / 行区间替换 / unified diff，全部带备份可撤销
description.en-US: Precise edits: string replace / line range / unified diff, all undoable via backup

tools.name: edit_replace
tools.description: Exact string replacement in a text file (the file must exist). Args: path (absolute), old_string (must match exactly once unless replace_all), new_string, replace_all (bool, default false). The original file is backed up automatically; the result carries {path, bytes, edits, backup} for fs_restore to undo.

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

tools.name: edit_lines
tools.description: Replace a 1-based inclusive line range in a text file (the file must exist). Args: path (absolute), start_line, end_line, content (new text for the range; empty content deletes it). The original file is backed up automatically; the result carries {path, bytes, replaced, backup} for fs_restore to undo.

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)

content.description: new text for the range; empty string deletes

tools.name: edit_diff
tools.description: Apply a unified diff to a text file (the file must exist). Args: path (absolute), patch (unified diff text with @@ hunks). Context lines must match exactly — no fuzz; on mismatch the tool errors and the file is untouched. The original file is backed up automatically; the result carries {path, bytes, hunks_applied, backup} for fs_restore to undo.

path.description: absolute file path (must be inside the allowed workspace roots; defaults to the app data dir)
